speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful. Can you tell me if you have noticed any unintentional weight loss, fatigue, or a change in your bowel habits over the past two weeks?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rectal bleeding daily with bowel movements. I also have No pain with defecation.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Carcinoma. Given the age, daily rectal bleeding, palpable mass, and lack of pain, malignancy is the primary concern; I recommend an immediate colonoscopy and biopsy for confirmation.
